hint.en: Written bottom-to-top with one long curve. Its katakana シ is the pair everyone mixes up with ツ: シ's strokes come in from the left and the long stroke sweeps up, while ツ's come down from the top.
hint.zh: 一笔由下往上带出长弧。片假名 シ 与 ツ 是最常被混淆的一对：シ 的短笔从左侧进入、长笔向上撇出，ツ 的短笔则从顶部向下。

hint.en: One stroke, left to right then curving down. Its katakana ツ has two short strokes on top, dropping downward — compare シ.
hint.zh: 一笔，先向右再向下弯。片假名 ツ 顶部有两短笔，方向朝下——与 シ 对比记忆。

hint.en: Katakana ソ is two strokes like ツ but written from the top down and slanting; ン slants up from the lower left. The difference is the direction of the long stroke, not its position.
hint.zh: 片假名 ソ 与 ツ 一样是两笔，但由上往下、笔画倾斜；ン 则自左下向上撇。区别在长笔的方向，而不是位置。

hint.en: The only kana that is not a full syllable: it is a mora on its own and never starts a word. Its katakana ン is easily confused with ソ.
hint.zh: 唯一不构成完整音节的假名：它自成一拍，且从不出现在词首。片假名 ン 容易与 ソ 混淆。

hint.en: Ends in a loop; め does not. Its katakana ヌ differs from ス by having no descending tail.
hint.zh: 结尾带一个圈；め 没有。片假名 ヌ 与 ス 的区别是没有向下的长尾。

hint.en: Like ぬ without the closing loop.
hint.zh: 像 ぬ，但没有末尾收笔的圈。

hint.en: A small loop with a long tail. Its katakana ス has a straight descending stroke — compare ヌ.
hint.zh: 一个小圈加一条长尾。片假名 ス 的下笔是直的——与 ヌ 对比。

hint.en: Compare ね (has a loop at the end) and れ (has a hook). All three share the same left side.
hint.zh: 与 ね（末端有圈）和 れ（末端有钩）对比。三者左半部分相同。

hint.en: The one with a loop at the end; わ has none, れ hooks outward.
hint.zh: 末端带圈的那个；わ 没有，れ 向外带钩。

hint.en: Ends in an outward hook, no loop.
hint.zh: 末端向外带钩，没有圈。

hint.en: Two separate strokes, left one longer. Compare り, whose strokes lean the other way.
hint.zh: 两笔分开，左边较长。与 り 对比，り 的两笔倾斜方向相反。

hint.en: Two strokes, the right one longer and curving left at the bottom.
hint.zh: 两笔，右边较长且底部向左弯。

hint.en: Built from a cross and a な-like right half; compare な, which has a loop.
hint.zh: 由一个十字和类似 な 的右半部组成；与 な 对比，な 的右下带圈。

hint.en: The loop at the lower right is what separates it from た.
hint.zh: 右下角的圈是它与 た 的区别。

hint.en: One stroke and no loop; る closes into a loop at the bottom.
hint.zh: 一笔且不收圈；る 在底部收成一个圈。

hint.en: Same shape as ろ but closing into a loop.
hint.zh: 与 ろ 形状相同，但末端收成一个圈。

hint.en: As the topic particle it is read wa, not ha. Compare ほ, which has one more horizontal stroke.
hint.zh: 作提示助词时读作 wa，不读 ha。与 ほ 对比，ほ 多一横。

hint.en: は with one extra horizontal stroke.
hint.zh: 在 は 的基础上多一横。

hint.en: As the direction particle it is read e, not he. The katakana ヘ is nearly identical to the hiragana.
hint.zh: 作方向助词时读作 e，不读 he。片假名 ヘ 与平假名几乎相同。

hint.en: Used only as the object particle, and pronounced o. You will never see it inside a word.
hint.zh: 只用作宾格助词，读作 o。不会出现在单词内部。

hint.en: Compare あ, which crosses its vertical stroke, and を, which is a particle only.
hint.zh: 与 あ 对比（あ 的竖笔穿过横笔），以及只作助词的 を。
